content.title: Refine Homes results with the Map after homepage search
content.intent: Prove the results page exposes the Map and supports location-based refinement for the current search.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a duplicate because an equivalent fresh scenario already exists. Techniques: pagination/search-list profile for collection refinement; state_flow because the path starts from routed search results. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.
